title: Small & Micro Wedding Venues in LA, With Prices
description: 6 small and micro wedding venues in Los Angeles, $320 to $2,600, each price from the venue's own site. Checked Oct 28, 2026.
h1: Small & micro wedding venues in Los Angeles
eyebrow: Los Angeles · prices from the venues' own pages
answer_html:
As of Oct 28, 2026, 6 small and micro wedding venues in Los Angeles print their own prices, from $320 (Albertson Wedding Chapel) to $2,600 (Greystone Mansion: ceremony only). For a group of 10 or more, the lowest is $449.99 (Lucky Wedding Day Chapel).

Each price and guest count is quoted from the venue's own website and shows the day we read it.

facts_note: A price is for the package the venue names, on the day we read it. Ask the venue about dates, taxes and fees.

faq.q: What is a normal cost for a wedding venue in Los Angeles?
faq.a: We do not quote an average, because an average hides what each venue actually prints. On this page 5 venues print prices from $320 to $2,600, each quoted from its own website on Oct 28, 2026.

faq.q: What are some cheap wedding venues in Los Angeles under $1,000?
faq.a: 4 of the 5 venues print a price under $1,000: Albertson Wedding Chapel $320; Lucky Wedding Day Chapel $449.99; Cute Little Wedding Chapel $450; Orcutt Ranch: weekday rental $900. Prices are for the package or hours each venue names, so read the row before you book.

faq.q: What is a small wedding considered?
faq.a: There is no official cutoff, so we use each venue's own words: the guest limits printed on this page run from 4 to 175 people. Every venue here prints its price for a small, micro, weekday or elopement booking.

faq.q: How much does a micro wedding cost in Los Angeles?
faq.a: The venue prices we verified run $320 to $2,600. Add the sample finds on this page (a $250 dress) to the cheapest venue and you get about $570 before catering, rings and tax.

faq.q: Is $5,000 enough for a wedding in Los Angeles?
faq.a: For a small group it can be: the cheapest verified venue ($320) plus the sample finds comes to about $570, and even the most expensive venue here is $2,600. A 100-guest wedding is a different budget, because this page prices small groups only.
